# Simple Strings

var s1 = 'hello';
var s2 = "world";

==>

Program(Declaration(VariableDeclaration("var",Identifier,"=",Literal(String(SingleString(SingleQuote,SingleQuoteEnd))),";")),Declaration(VariableDeclaration("var",Identifier,"=",Literal(String(DoubleString(DoubleQuote,DoubleQuoteEnd))),";")))

# Interpolation

var s = "hello $name";
var s2 = 'val: ${x + 1}';

==>

Program(Declaration(VariableDeclaration("var",Identifier,"=",Literal(String(DoubleString(DoubleQuote,InterpolationDouble(DoubleInterpolationStart,Identifier),DoubleQuoteEnd))),";")),Declaration(VariableDeclaration("var",Identifier,"=",Literal(String(SingleString(SingleQuote,InterpolationSingle(SingleInterpolationStart,"{",BinaryExpression(Identifier,"+",Literal(NumberLiteral)),"}"),SingleQuoteEnd))),";")))

# Escapes

var s = "a \" b";
var s2 = 'a \' b';

==>

Program(Declaration(VariableDeclaration("var",Identifier,"=",Literal(String(DoubleString(DoubleQuote,DoubleEscape,DoubleQuoteEnd))),";")),Declaration(VariableDeclaration("var",Identifier,"=",Literal(String(SingleString(SingleQuote,SingleEscape,SingleQuoteEnd))),";")))

# Adjacent Strings

var s = 'a' "b";

==>

Program(Declaration(VariableDeclaration("var",Identifier,"=",Literal(String(SingleString(SingleQuote,SingleQuoteEnd),DoubleString(DoubleQuote,DoubleQuoteEnd))),";")))

# Triple Strings

var s1 = '''multi
line''';
var s2 = """$interpolated""";

==>

Program(Declaration(VariableDeclaration("var",Identifier,"=",Literal(String(TripleSingleString(TripleSingleQuote,TripleSingleQuoteEnd))),";")),Declaration(VariableDeclaration("var",Identifier,"=",Literal(String(TripleDoubleString(TripleDoubleQuote,InterpolationTripleDouble(TripleDoubleInterpolationStart,Identifier),TripleDoubleQuoteEnd))),";")))

# Raw Strings

var r1 = r'no $interp';
var r2 = r"no \escapes";

==>

Program(Declaration(VariableDeclaration("var",Identifier,"=",Literal(String(RawString(RawSingleString(RawSingleQuote,RawSingleQuoteEnd)))),";")),Declaration(VariableDeclaration("var",Identifier,"=",Literal(String(RawString(RawDoubleString(RawDoubleQuote,RawDoubleQuoteEnd)))),";")))
